spec.claim_summary: The claim describes trading price against its slowest/lowest moving average across ten timeframes where more alignment means higher success.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical entry trigger, moving-average lengths, alignment definition, direction, or exits are stated so no repeatable rule can be recovered.
assumptions: No asset is named so BTCUSDT is used only as a schema placeholder.
No timeframe is named; 1d is used only as a schema placeholder despite mention of 10 different time frames.
No entry trigger is defined: MA length, lowest/slowest MA meaning, above/below versus cross, and long versus short direction are not stated.
No exit, stop, target, or holding rule is stated.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: alignment of signals across 10 different time frames and what counts as alignment, which is described as the heart of the system.
